method: Stagger: a swing that is parried by a guard or strikes a wall enters the native Recoil 40 over Running 0 (vtable RVA 0x1c83c98) with a sword_parry_* scene (666 or 733 ms); the source sends it as combat variant 28 (left) or 29 (right) with the scene clock, and the partner plays the native NPC parry-lose stagger (bank 73 clips 378-379). Until 1214dz the motion classifier did not accept Recoil 40 as an overlay, so the observer's playback refused the stagger as motion invalid (1418k, confirmed runtime). Knockdown: the lab shove (coop_lab_hit shove) knocks the source down natively (KnockedDown 16) and the partner plays the knockdown, the lying phase and the get-up (stun variant 5, bank 74 clip 380). Takes record the source states, the partner's combat and stun variants with their weights, and the observer film; 1435b/1440a swing into the lab room wall four times per role, 1403a/b shove the source from the front. 1440a's Corvo case failed only because its state sampler missed Recoil 40; the partner presented both staggers there (28, 29), which the source sends only from Recoil 40, and 1435b's Corvo case passed.

items.scope: Both roles: the recoil stagger after a parried or wall-struck swing (left and right) and the knockdown with the lying phase and the recovery to standing, presented on the partner from the native states.

visual.verdict: Emily recoils, drops to her knees, lies face down, pushes up to a crouch and rises to her guard.
Corvo drops to his knees, lies face down, pushes up to a crouch and rises to standing.
From behind her inside the room: Emily swings at the wall, her arms fly out wide and her body is thrown back off the blow, then she recovers to her guard.
From behind him inside the room: Corvo swings at the wall, his sword arm is flung back, his body twists and he stumbles back a step before recovering.
